description.value:
This collapsible pole has screens and cameras connected to it at all angles, with an oversized hardlight emoji at the top. It includes camera equipment that allows you to Livestream to the local infosphere across multiple platforms, making you appear extra likable in the process. You gain a +3 item bonus to skill checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Access Infosphere] by using the spell server to stream and asking viewers directly, and you can roll [[/act access-infosphere skill=perfomance]] instead of Computers to do so.

  • Cantrip emoticon

  • 1st emoji spray, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Motivating Ringtone]{motivating ringtone,} optics feed

  • 2nd emoji shield, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Sift the Sphere], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Vibe Check]

  • 3rd emoji spam, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Holographic Memory], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Motivating Ringtone]

  • 4th bombarding emojis, burstmoji, optics feed

  • 5th censormoji, prayermoji, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Speak with Computers]

  • 6th emoji spam, @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.Motivating Ringtone]
